title: Trellis K4/K6/K8 lm_head Quantization KLD
method: Trellis K{bits} round-trip on lm_head [248320, 5120] (untied from embeddings). Projects BF16 reference hidden states through both original BF16 head and trellis-quantized head, computing full-vocabulary KL divergence at every scored position. No vLLM model load needed — pure GPU matmul + KL. Same 512-context v5 shard-0000 suite (1,048,064 scored positions, vocab 248,320).

comparison_all_layers.notes: lm_head KLD is measured differently from embedding KLD: embedding KLD captures end-to-end model output after replacing embeddings and running full forward pass; lm_head KLD projects same BF16 hidden states through BF16 vs quantized head (isolates lm_head error only).

key_findings: lm_head K8 KLD (3.02e-05) is 88x lower than embedding K8 KLD (0.002653) — lm_head quantization at K8 is nearly free.
lm_head K6 KLD (3.15e-04) is 8.4x lower than embedding K6 KLD (0.002667) — still well within budget.
lm_head K4 KLD (0.004304) is 1.6x higher than embedding K4 KLD (0.002857) — K4 is where lm_head starts to hurt more than embeddings.

Surprisingly, lm_head K8 and K6 produce LOWER KLD than embedding K8 and K6. This is because the KLD measures different things: embedding KLD is end-to-end (error propagates through 48 layers), while lm_head KLD is isolated to the final projection (no propagation).
top1 agreement: K8=99.63%, K6=98.87%, K4=96.12%. Even K4 lm_head keeps >96% greedy agreement.
Proxy error scaling is consistent with embeddings: K4=0.00577, K6=0.00032, K8=0.00002 (~18x per 2-bit step).
Combined KLD budget if quantizing both embedding and lm_head at K8: 0.002653 + 0.000030 = 0.002683 (vs BF16 baseline 0.002700). Still under the 0.012 target.
At K6: combined = 0.002667 + 0.000315 = 0.002982. At K4: combined = 0.002857 + 0.004304 = 0.007161. K6 combined is 3.8x under budget; K4 combined is 1.7x under budget.
K4 lm_head is the crossover where lm_head error (0.004304) exceeds embedding error (0.002857). Below K6, lm_head is the dominant error source.
